name: Bozsok (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bozsok (a crowned red shield with a bunch of grapes within a yellow frame) above the name BOZSOK in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Bozsok arms with crown and frame
